successors.name: Nepal
successors.text: annexed to Nepal in 1774 after the Limbuwan-Gorkha War

ledger.x: 1609: Sen dynasty captures Morang; the page gives no founding year for Limbuwan, so the start is a bridge from the hint.
1774: annexed to Nepal after the Limbuwan-Gorkha War (1771-1774); agreement of Limbu ministers and the ten rulers with the King of Gorkha.

certainty.note: A confederation of ten kingdoms with no stated frontier dates.
